name: Process: Design the mentor pool and how a mentor is named
text_content:
P41 and P42. Eligibility per strand per domain: a closed plan with its goal held or a pre-opening ready form; no non-negotiable line; the mentor module complete; the seat or the strand in the domain; and a yes. The domain lead names from the pool at the offer, never themselves, the assessor, a person off the pool, or a person with an open plan already, matching for language and overlapping shifts and never for temperament. The mentor is paid as shift as a placed teaching body, carries the house's ways and the standard, and never scores, never writes on the person page, gives no verdict, and never sees the packet. No eligible mentor means no start date, as an infrastructure load. High.

Filed by Session 7 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhrz. Reasoning lives on the S7 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text: Session 13 priced authorship as a flat payment per module approved against the standard and again per versioned revision, paid with base pay, never a point, and never per completion by others, so that the standard's approval is the payment's trigger; and mentoring as a teaching marker on the mentor's points while a mentored plan is open, never per the mentee's outcome and never stacked because a mentor holds one open plan, with the mentor pool's eligibility unchanged. S13 page, sections 11.1 and 11.2; P32.
